headline: Colombia Remittance Inflows Reach $11.046 Billion Through October
summary: Remittance inflows to Colombia reached $11.046 billion through October, surpassing the total registration for the entire year of 2023.
why: Remittances represent a vital source of foreign exchange and household income supporting domestic consumption in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Record remittance inflows boost foreign exchange reserves and domestic consumer spending power.
